local function emit(s)
    io.write(s, "\n")
end
local function power2(n)
    return n > 0 and (n & (n - 1)) == 0
end
local function class(n)
    local k = 0
    while n >= 2 do
        n = n // 2
        k = k + 1
    end
    return k
end
local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap
function Heap:new(size, mode)
    local h =
        setmetatable(
        {
            size = size,
            mode = mode,
            blocks = {},
            ids = {},
            histories = {},
            roots = {},
            links = {},
            age = 0,
            rover = 0,
            peak = 0,
            ops = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}
        },
        self
    )
    h.blocks[1] = h:freeblock(0, size)
    return h
end
function Heap:freeblock(a, size)
    self.age = self.age + 1
    return {a = a, size = size, age = self.age}
end
function Heap:sort()
    table.sort(
        self.blocks,
        function(a, b)
            return a.a < b.a
        end
    )
end
function Heap:index(block)
    for i, b in ipairs(self.blocks) do
        if b == block then
            return i
        end
    end
end
function Heap:required(n)
    local s = ((n + 7) // 8) * 8 + 8
    if self.mode == "BUDDY" then
        local p = 32
        while p < s do
            p = p * 2
        end
        return p
    end
    return s
end
function Heap:allocate(s, al)
    local choices = {}
    local start = 1
    for i, b in ipairs(self.blocks) do
        if b.a <= self.rover and self.rover < b.a + b.size then
            start = i
        end
        if not b.used then
            local p = ((b.a + 8 + al - 1) // al) * al - 8
            if p - b.a > 0 and p - b.a < 16 then
                p = p + al
            end
            if p + s <= b.a + b.size then
                choices[#choices + 1] = {b = b, p = p, i = i}
            end
        end
    end
    if #choices == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local mode = self.mode
    table.sort(
        choices,
        function(x, y)
            local a, b = x.b, y.b
            if mode == "NEXT" then
                return (x.i - start + #self.blocks) % #self.blocks <
                    (y.i - start + #self.blocks) % #self.blocks
            elseif mode == "BEST" or mode == "BUDDY" then
                if a.size ~= b.size then
                    return a.size < b.size
                end
            elseif mode == "WORST" then
                if a.size ~= b.size then
                    return a.size > b.size
                end
            elseif mode == "SEGFIT" then
                if class(a.size) ~= class(b.size) then
                    return class(a.size) < class(b.size)
                end
                return a.age > b.age
            end
            return a.a < b.a
        end
    )
    local c = choices[1]
    local b, p = c.b, c.p
    table.remove(self.blocks, c.i)
    local used
    if mode == "BUDDY" then
        local z = b.size
        while z > s do
            z = z // 2
            self.blocks[#self.blocks + 1] = self:freeblock(b.a + z, z)
        end
        used = {a = b.a, size = s, used = true}
    else
        if p > b.a then
            self.blocks[#self.blocks + 1] = self:freeblock(b.a, p - b.a)
        end
        local z = b.a + b.size - p
        used = {a = p, size = (z - s >= 16 and s or z), used = true}
        if z - s >= 16 then
            self.blocks[#self.blocks + 1] = self:freeblock(p + s, z - s)
        end
    end
    self.blocks[#self.blocks + 1] = used
    self:sort()
    if mode == "NEXT" then
        self.rover = (used.a + used.size) % self.size
    end
    return used
end
function Heap:release(b)
    b.used, b.id, b.req, b.data = nil, nil, nil, nil
    local merges = 0
    if self.mode == "BUDDY" then
        while b.size < self.size do
            local buddy = b.a ~ b.size
            local found
            for i, c in ipairs(self.blocks) do
                if c ~= b and not c.used and c.a == buddy and c.size == b.size then
                    found = i
                    break
                end
            end
            if not found then
                break
            end
            table.remove(self.blocks, found)
            b.a, b.size = math.min(b.a, buddy), b.size * 2
            merges = merges + 1
        end
        self:sort()
    else
        local i = self:index(b)
        local nextb = self.blocks[i + 1]
        if nextb and not nextb.used then
            b.size = b.size + nextb.size
            table.remove(self.blocks, i + 1)
            merges = merges + 1
        end
        local prev = self.blocks[i - 1]
        if prev and not prev.used then
            b.a, b.size = prev.a, b.size + prev.size
            table.remove(self.blocks, i - 1)
            merges = merges + 1
        end
    end
    self.age = self.age + 1
    b.age = self.age
    return b, merges
end
function Heap:record(id, line)
    self.histories[id] = self.histories[id] or {}
    table.insert(self.histories[id], line)
    emit(line)
end
function Heap:state(id)
    local b = self.ids[id]
    if type(b) == "table" then
        return b
    end
    emit("ERROR " .. (b == false and "USE AFTER FREE " or "UNKNOWN ID ") .. id)
end
function Heap:forget(id)
    self.ids[id], self.roots[id], self.links[id] = false, nil, nil
    for _, edges in pairs(self.links) do
        edges[id] = nil
    end
end
function Heap:freeid(id, kind)
    local b = self.ids[id]
    if type(b) ~= "table" then
        emit("ERROR " .. (b == false and "DOUBLE FREE " or "UNKNOWN ID ") .. id)
        return
    end
    local size = b.size
    local f, m = self:release(b)
    self:forget(id)
    if kind == "FREE" then
        self.ops[2] = self.ops[2] + 1
    else
        self.ops[6] = self.ops[6] + 1
    end
    self:record(
        id,
        kind ..
            " " .. id .. " block=" .. size .. " merges=" .. m .. " free=" .. f.a .. "+" .. f.size
    )
end
function Heap:malloc(id, n, al, kind)
    if n == 0 then
        emit("ERROR BAD SIZE")
        return
    end
    if type(self.ids[id]) == "table" then
        emit("ERROR DUPLICATE ID " .. id)
        return
    end
    local b = self:allocate(self:required(n), al)
    if not b then
        self.ops[5] = self.ops[5] + 1
        emit("ERROR OUT OF MEMORY " .. id)
        return
    end
    b.id, b.req, b.data = id, n, {}
    if kind == "CALLOC" then
        for i = 1, n do
            b.data[i] = 0
        end
    end
    self.ids[id] = b
    self.ops[1] = self.ops[1] + 1
    self:record(id, kind .. " " .. id .. " addr=" .. (b.a + 8) .. " block=" .. b.size)
end
function Heap:realloc(id, n)
    if n == 0 then
        self:freeid(id, "FREE")
        return
    end
    if self.ids[id] == nil then
        self:malloc(id, n, 8, "MALLOC")
        return
    end
    local b = self:state(id)
    if not b then
        return
    end
    local a, oldsize, oldreq, data = b.a, b.size, b.req, b.data
    local s, kind = self:required(n), nil
    if s <= b.size then
        kind = "kept"
        if self.mode == "BUDDY" then
            if s < b.size then
                kind = "shrunk"
            end
            while b.size > s do
                b.size = b.size // 2
                self.blocks[#self.blocks + 1] = self:freeblock(a + b.size, b.size)
            end
            self:sort()
        elseif b.size - s >= 16 then
            local i = self:index(b)
            local z = b.size - s
            b.size = s
            local c = self.blocks[i + 1]
            if c and not c.used then
                z = z + c.size
                table.remove(self.blocks, i + 1)
            end
            table.insert(self.blocks, i + 1, self:freeblock(a + s, z))
            kind = "shrunk"
        end
    elseif self.mode ~= "BUDDY" then
        local i = self:index(b)
        local c = self.blocks[i + 1]
        if c and not c.used and b.size + c.size >= s then
            local z = b.size + c.size
            table.remove(self.blocks, i + 1)
            b.size = z - s >= 16 and s or z
            if z - s >= 16 then
                table.insert(self.blocks, i + 1, self:freeblock(a + s, z - s))
            end
            kind = "grown"
        end
    else
        local absorbed = {}
        local t = b.size
        while t < s and a % (2 * t) == 0 do
            local found
            for _, c in ipairs(self.blocks) do
                if not c.used and c.a == a + t and c.size == t then
                    found = c
                    break
                end
            end
            if not found then
                break
            end
            absorbed[#absorbed + 1] = found
            t = t * 2
        end
        if t == s then
            for _, c in ipairs(absorbed) do
                table.remove(self.blocks, self:index(c))
            end
            b.size = s
            kind = "grown"
        end
    end
    if not kind then
        local dest = self:allocate(s, 8)
        if not dest then
            self.ops[5] = self.ops[5] + 1
            emit("ERROR OUT OF MEMORY " .. id)
            return
        end
        self:release(b)
        b = dest
        b.id = id
        self.ids[id] = b
        kind = "moved"
        self.ops[4] = self.ops[4] + 1
    end
    b.req, b.data = n, data
    for i = n + 1, oldreq do
        data[i] = nil
    end
    self.ops[3] = self.ops[3] + 1
    local line = "REALLOC " .. id .. " addr=" .. (b.a + 8) .. " block=" .. b.size .. " " .. kind
    if kind == "moved" then
        line = line .. " from=" .. (a + 8)
    end
    self:record(id, line)
end
function Heap:reachable()
    local seen, stack = {}, {}
    for id in pairs(self.roots) do
        stack[#stack + 1] = id
    end
    while #stack > 0 do
        local id = table.remove(stack)
        if not seen[id] then
            seen[id] = true
            for dst in pairs(self.links[id] or {}) do
                stack[#stack + 1] = dst
            end
        end
    end
    return seen
end
function Heap:totals()
    local u, f, l, ub, fb, r = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
    for _, b in ipairs(self.blocks) do
        if b.used then
            u = u + b.size
            ub = ub + 1
            r = r + (b.req or 0)
        else
            f = f + b.size
            l = math.max(l, b.size)
            fb = fb + 1
        end
    end
    return u, f, l, ub, fb, r, (f > 0 and (f - l) * 100 // f or 0)
end
local function bench(size, seed, ops, maxreq)
    if size < 32 or size > 65536 or not power2(size) then
        emit("ERROR BAD HEAP SIZE")
        return
    end
    emit("BENCH heap=" .. size .. " seed=" .. seed .. " ops=" .. ops .. " maxreq=" .. maxreq)
    for _, mode in ipairs({"FIRST", "NEXT", "BEST", "WORST", "SEGFIT", "BUDDY"}) do
        local h, x, live, ok, fail, peak = Heap:new(size, mode), seed, {}, 0, 0, 0
        for _ = 1, ops do
            x = 48271 * x % 2147483647
            local alloc = #live == 0 or x % 3 ~= 0
            x = 48271 * x % 2147483647
            if alloc then
                local b = h:allocate(h:required(1 + x % maxreq), 8)
                if b then
                    live[#live + 1] = b
                    ok = ok + 1
                else
                    fail = fail + 1
                end
            else
                h:release(table.remove(live, 1 + x % #live))
            end
            local used = h:totals()
            peak = math.max(peak, used)
        end
        local u, _, _, _, _, _, frag = h:totals()
        emit(
            "BENCH " ..
                mode ..
                    " ok=" ..
                        ok ..
                            " fail=" ..
                                fail ..
                                    " peak=" ..
                                        peak ..
                                            " used=" ..
                                                u .. " frag=" .. frag .. " blocks=" .. #h.blocks
        )
    end
end
local heap
local function command(t)
    local cmd, id = t[1], t[2]
    local function num(i)
        return tonumber(t[i])
    end
    if cmd == "BENCH" then
        bench(num(2), num(3), num(4), num(5))
        return
    end
    if cmd == "HEAP" then
        local s, mode = num(2), t[3]
        if s < 32 or s > 65536 or s % 8 ~= 0 or (mode == "BUDDY" and not power2(s)) then
            emit("ERROR BAD HEAP SIZE")
        else
            heap = Heap:new(s, mode)
            emit("HEAP size=" .. s .. " mode=" .. mode)
        end
        return
    end
    local h = heap
    if not h then
        emit("ERROR NO HEAP")
        return
    end
    if cmd == "MALLOC" or cmd == "CALLOC" or cmd == "MEMALIGN" then
        local al, n = 8, num(3)
        if cmd == "CALLOC" then
            n = num(3) * num(4)
        end
        if cmd == "MEMALIGN" then
            if h.mode == "BUDDY" then
                emit("ERROR UNSUPPORTED IN BUDDY MODE")
                return
            end
            al, n = num(3), num(4)
            if al < 8 or al > 4096 or not power2(al) then
                emit("ERROR BAD ALIGNMENT")
                return
            end
        end
        h:malloc(id, n, al, cmd)
    elseif cmd == "FREE" then
        h:freeid(id, "FREE")
    elseif cmd == "REALLOC" then
        h:realloc(id, num(3))
    elseif cmd == "FILL" or cmd == "READ" or cmd == "COPY" then
        local b = h:state(id)
        if not b then
            return
        end
        local off, len = num(3), num(cmd == "COPY" and 6 or 4)
        if off + len > b.req then
            emit("ERROR OUT OF BOUNDS " .. id)
            return
        end
        if cmd == "FILL" then
            for i = off + 1, off + len do
                b.data[i] = num(5)
            end
            emit("FILL " .. id .. " " .. off .. "+" .. len .. " = " .. num(5))
        elseif cmd == "READ" then
            local values = {}
            for i = off + 1, off + len do
                values[#values + 1] = b.data[i] ~= nil and tostring(b.data[i]) or "?"
            end
            emit("READ " .. id .. " " .. off .. "+" .. len .. " = " .. table.concat(values, " "))
        else
            local src, soff = t[4], num(5)
            local c = h:state(src)
            if not c then
                return
            end
            if soff + len > c.req then
                emit("ERROR OUT OF BOUNDS " .. src)
                return
            end
            local values = {}
            for i = 1, len do
                values[i] = c.data[soff + i] or false
            end
            for i = 1, len do
                b.data[off + i] = values[i] ~= false and values[i] or nil
            end
            emit("COPY " .. id .. " " .. off .. "+" .. len .. " from " .. src .. " " .. soff)
        end
    elseif cmd == "ROOT" or cmd == "UNROOT" then
        if not h:state(id) then
            return
        end
        if cmd == "UNROOT" and not h.roots[id] then
            emit("ERROR NOT ROOT " .. id)
            return
        end
        h.roots[id] = cmd == "ROOT" or nil
        emit(cmd .. " " .. id)
    elseif cmd == "LINK" or cmd == "UNLINK" then
        if not h:state(id) or not h:state(t[3]) then
            return
        end
        h.links[id] = h.links[id] or {}
        if cmd == "UNLINK" and not h.links[id][t[3]] then
            emit("ERROR NO LINK " .. id .. " " .. t[3])
            return
        end
        h.links[id][t[3]] = cmd == "LINK" or nil
        emit(cmd .. " " .. id .. " " .. t[3])
    elseif cmd == "GC" then
        local reachable, list, bytes = h:reachable(), {}, 0
        for _, b in ipairs(h.blocks) do
            if b.used and not reachable[b.id] then
                list[#list + 1] = b.id
                bytes = bytes + b.size
            end
        end
        emit("GC collected=" .. #list .. " bytes=" .. bytes)
        for _, v in ipairs(list) do
            h:freeid(v, "COLLECT")
        end
    elseif cmd == "SBRK" then
        local k = num(2)
        if
            h.size + k > 65536 or (h.mode == "BUDDY" and k ~= h.size) or
                (h.mode ~= "BUDDY" and (k < 16 or k % 8 ~= 0))
         then
            emit("ERROR BAD SBRK SIZE")
            return
        end
        local b = {a = h.size, size = k}
        h.blocks[#h.blocks + 1] = b
        h.size = h.size + k
        h:release(b)
        emit("SBRK heap=" .. h.size .. " free=" .. b.a .. "+" .. b.size)
    elseif cmd == "TRIM" then
        local old = h.size
        if h.mode == "BUDDY" then
            while #h.blocks > 1 and not h.blocks[#h.blocks].used and
                h.blocks[#h.blocks].size == h.size // 2 do
                h.size = h.size // 2
                table.remove(h.blocks)
            end
        elseif #h.blocks > 1 and not h.blocks[#h.blocks].used then
            h.size = h.blocks[#h.blocks].a
            table.remove(h.blocks)
        end
        if h.rover >= h.size then
            h.rover = 0
        end
        emit("TRIM heap=" .. h.size .. " released=" .. (old - h.size))
    elseif cmd == "COMPACT" then
        if h.mode == "BUDDY" then
            emit("ERROR UNSUPPORTED IN BUDDY MODE")
            return
        end
        local blocks, moves, pos = {}, {}, 0
        for _, b in ipairs(h.blocks) do
            if b.used then
                if b.a ~= pos then
                    moves[#moves + 1] = {
                        id = b.id,
                        line = "MOVE " .. b.id .. " " .. (b.a + 8) .. " -> " .. (pos + 8)
                    }
                end
                b.a = pos
                pos = pos + b.size
                blocks[#blocks + 1] = b
            end
        end
        if pos < h.size then
            blocks[#blocks + 1] = h:freeblock(pos, h.size - pos)
        end
        h.blocks, h.rover = blocks, 0
        h.ops[4] = h.ops[4] + #moves
        emit(
            "COMPACT moved=" ..
                #moves .. " free=" .. (pos < h.size and pos .. "+" .. (h.size - pos) or "none")
        )
        for _, m in ipairs(moves) do
            h:record(m.id, m.line)
        end
    elseif cmd == "WHO" then
        local p = num(2)
        if p >= h.size then
            emit("WHO " .. p .. " outside")
            return
        end
        for _, b in ipairs(h.blocks) do
            if b.a <= p and p < b.a + b.size then
                local result
                if not b.used then
                    result = "free " .. b.a .. "+" .. b.size
                elseif p < b.a + 8 then
                    result = "header " .. b.id
                else
                    local d = p - b.a - 8
                    result = (d < b.req and "data " or "slack ") .. b.id .. "+" .. d
                end
                emit("WHO " .. p .. " " .. result)
                break
            end
        end
    elseif cmd == "DUMP" then
        emit(
            "DUMP mode=" ..
                h.mode ..
                    " heap=" ..
                        h.size ..
                            " blocks=" ..
                                #h.blocks .. (h.mode == "NEXT" and " rover=" .. h.rover or "")
        )
        for _, b in ipairs(h.blocks) do
            emit(
                b.a .. " " .. b.size .. (b.used and " USED " .. b.id .. " req=" .. b.req or " FREE")
            )
        end
    elseif cmd == "MAP" then
        emit("MAP heap=" .. h.size)
        local units = {}
        for _, b in ipairs(h.blocks) do
            units[#units + 1] = b.used and "H" or "F"
            for k = 0, b.size // 8 - 2 do
                units[#units + 1] = b.used and (8 * k < b.req and "#" or "-") or "."
            end
        end
        for i = 1, #units, 64 do
            emit(
                string.format(
                    "%05d %s",
                    (i - 1) * 8,
                    table.concat(units, "", i, math.min(i + 63, #units))
                )
            )
        end
    elseif cmd == "FREELIST" then
        local groups, count = {}, 0
        for _, b in ipairs(h.blocks) do
            if not b.used then
                local k = class(b.size)
                groups[k] = groups[k] or {}
                table.insert(groups[k], b)
                count = count + 1
            end
        end
        emit("FREELIST count=" .. count)
        for k = 0, 16 do
            if groups[k] then
                if h.mode == "SEGFIT" then
                    table.sort(
                        groups[k],
                        function(a, b)
                            return a.age > b.age
                        end
                    )
                end
                local items = {}
                for _, b in ipairs(groups[k]) do
                    items[#items + 1] = b.a .. "+" .. b.size
                end
                emit((1 << k) .. "-" .. ((1 << (k + 1)) - 1) .. ": " .. table.concat(items, " "))
            end
        end
    elseif cmd == "TREE" then
        if h.mode ~= "BUDDY" then
            emit("ERROR REQUIRES BUDDY MODE")
            return
        end
        emit("TREE heap=" .. h.size)
        local function tree(a, s, depth)
            local prefix = string.rep(" ", 2 * depth) .. a .. "+" .. s
            for _, b in ipairs(h.blocks) do
                if b.a == a and b.size == s then
                    emit(prefix .. (b.used and " USED " .. b.id or " FREE"))
                    return
                end
            end
            emit(prefix .. " split")
            tree(a, s // 2, depth + 1)
            tree(a + s // 2, s // 2, depth + 1)
        end
        tree(0, h.size, 0)
    elseif cmd == "STATS" then
        local u, f, l, ub, fb, r, frag = h:totals()
        emit(
            "STATS used=" ..
                u ..
                    " used_blocks=" ..
                        ub ..
                            " free=" ..
                                f ..
                                    " free_blocks=" ..
                                        fb ..
                                            " largest=" ..
                                                l ..
                                                    " frag=" ..
                                                        frag ..
                                                            " requested=" .. r .. " peak=" .. h.peak
        )
        local o = h.ops
        emit(
            "OPS allocs=" ..
                o[1] ..
                    " frees=" ..
                        o[2] ..
                            " reallocs=" ..
                                o[3] ..
                                    " moves=" ..
                                        o[4] .. " failures=" .. o[5] .. " collected=" .. o[6]
        )
    elseif cmd == "LEAKS" then
        local reach, list, req, lost = h:reachable(), {}, 0, 0
        for id, b in pairs(h.ids) do
            if type(b) == "table" then
                list[#list + 1] = id
                req = req + b.req
                if not reach[id] then
                    lost = lost + 1
                end
            end
        end
        table.sort(list)
        emit("LEAKS count=" .. #list .. " requested=" .. req .. " lost=" .. lost)
        for _, id in ipairs(list) do
            local b = h.ids[id]
            emit(
                "LEAK " ..
                    id ..
                        " addr=" ..
                            (b.a + 8) ..
                                " block=" ..
                                    b.size ..
                                        " req=" ..
                                            b.req .. " " .. (reach[id] and "reachable" or "lost")
            )
        end
    elseif cmd == "HISTORY" then
        local history = h.histories[id] or {}
        emit("HISTORY " .. id .. " events=" .. #history)
        for _, line in ipairs(history) do
            emit(line)
        end
    end
end
local n = tonumber(io.read())
for _ = 1, n do
    local t = {}
    for word in io.read():gmatch("%S+") do
        t[#t + 1] = word
    end
    command(t)
    if heap then
        local used = heap:totals()
        heap.peak = math.max(heap.peak, used)
    end
end
